title: What If...?
summary: Nandi sits on the steps of her house and thinks about all kinds of strange and wonderful things. It all begins with one simple question: what if...?
pages: Nandi sat on the blue steps of her house.

What if jelly beans made you jump really high?
You could get to school in one big jump!

What if goats and chickens could talk?
Would they tell good jokes?

What if houses were spaceships?
The whole family could fly to the moon on vacation!

What if nobody had to cook? What if dinner just appeared on the table?
(And it was always your favorite food.)

What if ice pops never melted?
They would last all summer long.
What if the pictures in books flew around your head when Dad reads you a story?

What if my pink rain boots were magic boots?
I could run faster than my big brother!
What if you squeeze your eyes shut really tight and...

"Nandi, what are you doing?" asked Nandi's big brother.
Nandi leaned back on the step, with a big smile on her face.
